questions.explanation: 'Het afval' is waste or rubbish that you throw away.
'Het gemeentehuis' is the town hall, the building of the municipality.

questions.prompt: Kies het juiste lidwoord: ___ verzekering betaalt de schade.
questions.explanation: 'Verzekering' is a de-woord (words ending in -ing are de-woorden): 'de verzekering'.
With 'we' the verb keeps its plural form 'scheiden'.

questions.prompt: Dit is plastic. Waar {{1}} je het in? (gooien)
questions.explanation: In a question with 'je' after the verb, the -t drops: 'gooi je'.
After the modal verb 'wil', the second verb stays an infinitive at the end: 'regelen'.

questions.prompt: Als er schade is, betaalt de verzekering. Dan ben je goed ___. (Engels: insured)

questions.explanation: Empty bottles are made of glass, so they go with 'het glas'.
